verdict.summary:
VERDICT: REQUEST CHANGES

=== PER-REGION OBSERVATIONS ===
1. Desktop Band 1 dark & light (00-v4-desk.png top; 01-v4-mob.png top):
- Header: Avatar 'r', 'rebuildup', subtitle, green 'online on Discord', top-right 'observed Nov 24 · 23:00 JST' all clean.
- Vitals row (4 cards): Flame cleanly separated from '204'; TOP LANGUAGE bar + 'TypeScript 45.8%' + 'C# 40.9 · C++ 7.9 · +3' (no color swatches); 'CONTRIBUTED TO · 27 REPOS' header cleanly above 3 dot rows (10+10+7, no collision; '1y' omitted); GITHUB RANK 'B+' ring with 'of A+ tier' cleanly positioned to its right.
- IN PROGRESS · DECLARED FOCUS: Heading sits very close to bottom edge of vitals cards; all 4 projects (my-web-2026, AI coding agent, Tastile, After Effects) fit horizontally with scaled rings, icons, subtitles, and 3/2/1 weight bars cleanly below subtitles (no clipping, no collisions). However, the weight-segment legend was deleted on desktop.

2. Desktop Band 2 dark & light (00-v4-desk.png mid; 01-v4-mob.png mid):
- Left panel (REPO OUTPUT · 30D): 10 rows (FlashBeat through ube-kosen-map, faint divider, +22 more public 152c 101p, private repos · sum 1.5kc 540p). No longer bleeds into 72h panel, no truncation, no unexplained hollow dots. HOWEVER, on all 10 rows the purple PR squares (▪) collide directly over the numeric count column (2.1kc 572p .. 1.5kc 540p), and long blue commit-dot rows run into wrapped PR-square blocks. Dark-mode aggregate rows/counts remain dim.
- Right panel (LAST 72 HOURS): Legend 'push PR new del' stays inside top-left of box but has NO visible shape icons. Plot area (-72h, -48h, -24h, now) is COMPLETELY EMPTY (0 markers plotted). Below box, 3 recent push rows ('11/24 02:46 JST', '02:22 JST', '01:59 JST') fit cleanly without right-edge clipping, and '29 public events · times JST' sits cleanly below row 3 without colliding—yet directly contradicts the empty chart.

3. Mobile Band 1 dark & light (00-v4-desk.png & 01-v4-mob.png bottom):
- Header clean ('Nov 24 · 23:00 JST'). 2x2 vitals restore primary '45.8%' and 'of A+ tier' (isolated bottom-right, dim in dark) plus 'CONTRIBUTED · 1Y' with 27 dots and '27', but still omit secondary languages ('C# 40.9 · C++ 7.9 · +3').
- IN PROGRESS stacks all 4 projects cleanly with weight bars. Tiny bottom-right legend ('■■■ primary ■■ active ■ side') sits after large empty space, uses squares instead of dashes, and is low contrast in dark mode / sub-legible if scaled to 350px.

4. Mobile Band 2 dark & light (00-v4-desk.png & 01-v4-mob.png bottom):
- Top panel (REPO OUTPUT · 30D): Linear commit bars replace 42-dot rows (great for narrow widths) and restore PR metrics ('572p' etc. + ▪ squares). Consistent 6 + 24 = 30 repo math (+24 more public = 374c 211p). HOWEVER, PR squares are clamped at 4 on FlashBeat (572p), my-web-2026 (352p), and private · sum (540p) — matching dotfiles (96p) while +24 more public (211p) gets 8 squares. Slight descender tightness on 'project-init', low dark-mode contrast on counts/aggregates, and very faint '+24 more public' on mobile light.
- Bottom panel (LAST 72 HOURS): Completely empty plot box (0 markers), 'push PR new del' has no shape icons, and 3 feed rows omit 'JST' and the '29 public events · times JST' footer.

=== BLOCKER VERIFICATION ===
v15 Blockers:
- #0 (Band1 collisions: 27 repos/dots, weight bars/subtitle, legend/After Effects): PARTIAL — all 3 collisions are eliminated, but desktop weight-bar legend was deleted rather than relocated (information deletion).
- #1 (Band2: right-edge timestamp clip, row3/footer collision, 'new' legend overflow): FIXED — timestamps fit, footer clears row 3, legend stays inside chart box.
- #2 (Band2 mobile 72h chart empty): NOT FIXED — still empty on mobile AND regressed to empty on desktop.
- #3 (Mobile deleted PR metrics, lang %, rank tier): PARTIAL — PR counts, primary lang %, and rank tier restored, but secondary languages still omitted on mobile and mobile PR squares are mis-clamped at 4.
- #4 (Dark-mode muted text/counts low contrast): PARTIAL — Band 1 subtitles slightly better, but Band 2 dark counts/aggregates/ticks and mobile muted labels/legends remain low contrast.
- #5 (72h event-type shapes unreadable desktop / absent mobile): NOT FIXED — legend lacks visible shapes and chart renders zero plotted markers across desktop and mobile.

v14 Blockers:
- #1 (Band1 After Effects clipped, bottom clip, label/glyph/ring overlaps): FIXED.
- #2 (Band2 dot overrun, 'private repos (aggrega' clip, hollow dots, JST/UTC mismatch): NOT FIXED — truncation, hollow dots, and desktop JST consistency are fixed, but PR squares & long dot rows still severely collide over counts on all 10 desktop rows.
- #3 (Band1 vitals collisions): FIXED.
- #4 (Mobile 4-5px text & 42-dot rows): PARTIAL — 42-dot rows fixed via linear bars; primary text improved, but micro-legends/axis ticks/sub-labels remain too small for 350px.
- #5 (Dark-mode muted contrast): PARTIAL — unresolved in Band 2 and mobile muted elements.
- #6 (72h color-only identical diamonds): NOT FIXED — chart is empty and legend shapes are missing.

v14 Polish Verification:
- Band1 vitals boxing vs IN PROGRESS hierarchy: NOT FIXED (vitals boxes still dominate; heading sits tight under cards).
- Weight-segment grammar clarity: PARTIAL (desktop legend deleted; mobile legend tiny/square/detached).
- TOP LANGUAGE secondary color swatches: NOT FIXED (no swatches on desktop; labels omitted on mobile).
- Band2 leftBottom rule position: FIXED/ACCEPTABLE (separates individual vs aggregate repos, though faint in dark).
- Recent-events JST labels & 'times JST' footer honesty: FIXED on desktop (omitted on mobile; however '29 public events' contradicts the empty 72h chart).

=== PER-BAND M1–M7 ASSESSMENT (Dark / Light) ===
Band 1 — Dark | Light:
- M1 Text-dependence: MET | MET
- M2 Visual semantics: PARTIAL | PARTIAL (missing desktop weight legend & secondary lang swatches)
- M3 Glance: MET | MET
- M4 Hierarchy: PARTIAL | PARTIAL (vitals boxing dominates; tight heading gap)
- M5 Honesty/legibility: PARTIAL | MET (dark muted contrast & deleted desktop legend/1y/mobile secondary langs)
- M6 GitHub fitness: MET | MET
- M7 Improvement vs current: MET | MET

Band 2 — Dark | Light:
- M1 Text-dependence: PARTIAL | PARTIAL (blank 72h chart forces reliance on text list)
- M2 Visual semantics: MISSING | MISSING (missing 72h shapes; broken mobile PR square scaling)
- M3 Glance: MISSING | MISSING (desktop PR-square/count collisions; blank 72h panel)
- M4 Hierarchy: PARTIAL | PARTIAL
- M5 Honesty/legibility: MISSING | MISSING (obscured desktop counts; empty chart vs '29 public events'; mis-clamped mobile PR squares; low contrast)
- M6 GitHub fitness: PARTIAL | PARTIAL
- M7 Improvement vs current: PARTIAL | PARTIAL

=== PRIORITY RANKING ===
BLOCKERS (6): (1) Desktop Band 2 PR squares & dots colliding over counts on all 10 rows; (2) Empty 72h pulse charts on desktop & mobile; (3) Missing 72h event-type shapes in legend & plot; (4) Mobile Band 2 PR squares clamped at 4 on 572p/352p/540p vs 8 on 211p; (5) Dark-mode & mobile-light low contrast on muted counts/aggregates/ticks/legends; (6) Mobile 350px micro-label legibility & deleted desktop weight legend / mobile secondary language %.
POLISH (4): (1) Restore non-colliding desktop weight-bar legend with matching dashes; (2) Add inline color swatches to TOP LANGUAGE secondary items; (3) Rebalance Band 1 vitals boxing vs IN PROGRESS spacing and mobile 'of A+ tier' placement; (4) Add descender spacing on mobile Band 2 and restore mobile JST/footer parity.
